mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25 percentage points over the prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp over the prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a supply-side shock (e.g., production disruption without job losses), which increases economic uncertainty and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decline > 0.5% and PAYEMS rise > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (defined by consecutive FEDFUNDS increases), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts level exceeding 2050 thousand units signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where HOUST exceeds 2050, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rise > 1.0% in 1 month and GDPC1 rise > 0.5% in latest quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior month signals strong consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where RSAFS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where INDPRO falls by more than 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
